  <script>
    /* ── Carousel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carousel-prev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carousel-next');
      const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');

      let currentIndex = 0;
      let cardWidth = 0;
      let visibleCount = 4;
      const totalCards = track.children.length;

      function getVisibleCount() {
        const w = window.innerWidth;
        if (w <= 500)  return 1;
        if (w <= 900)  return 2;
        if (w <= 1100) return 3;
        return 4;
      }

      function maxIndex() {
        return Math.max(0, totalCards - visibleCount);
      }

      function updateCardWidth() {
        visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
        const outer = track.parentElement;
        const gap = 20;
        cardWidth = (outer.offsetWidth - gap * (visibleCount - 1)) / visibleCount;
        Array.from(track.children).forEach(c => { c.style.flex = `0 0 ${cardWidth}px`; });
      }

      function goTo(index) {
        currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, maxIndex()));
        const offset = currentIndex * (cardWidth + 20);
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;

        const dotCount = dots.length;
        const step = maxIndex() / Math.max(1, dotCount - 1);
        dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
          const active = Math.round(i * step) === currentIndex;
          dot.classList.toggle('active', active);
          dot.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        });

        prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= maxIndex();
        prevBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex === 0 ? '.45' : '1';
        nextBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex >= maxIndex() ? '.45' : '1';
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex - 1));
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex + 1));

      dots.forEach(dot => {
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dotIndex = parseInt(dot.dataset.index, 10);
          const step = maxIndex() / Math.max(1, dots.length - 1);
          goTo(Math.round(dotIndex * step));
        });
      });

      let resizeTimer;
      window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          updateCardWidth();
          goTo(Math.min(currentIndex, maxIndex()));
        }, 120);
      });

      updateCardWidth();
      goTo(0);
    })();

    /* ── Store Locator ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('locator-form');
      const resultsEl = document.getElementById('store-results');
      const emptyEl = document.getElementById('store-empty');

      const stores = [
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Lincoln Park',  address: '2140 N. Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60614', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '0.8 mi' },
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Wicker Park',   address: '1840 W. North Ave, Chicago, IL 60622', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '1.4 mi' },
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Lakeview',       address: '3745 N. Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60613', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '2.1 mi' },
      ];

      const mapIcon = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z"/></svg>`;

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const zip = document.getElementById('zip-input').value.trim();
        if (!zip) return;

        const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        btn.textContent = 'Searching…';
        btn.disabled = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15.5 14h-.79l-.28-.27A6.471 6.471 0 0 0 16 9.5 6.5 6.5 0 1 0 9.5 16c1.61 0 3.09-.59 4.23-1.57l.27.28v.79l5 4.99L20.49 19l-4.99-5zm-6 0C7.01 14 5 11.99 5 9.5S7.01 5 9.5 5 14 7.01 14 9.5 11.99 14 9.5 14z"/></svg> Search`;
          btn.disabled = false;

          if (emptyEl) emptyEl.remove();

          resultsEl.innerHTML = '';

          stores.forEach((s, i) => {
            const card = document.createElement('article');
            card.className = 'store-card';
            card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            card.setAttribute('aria-label', `${s.name}, ${s.distance} away`);
            card.style.animationDelay = `${i * 80}ms`;
            card.innerHTML = `
              <div class="store-icon">${mapIcon}</div>
              <div class="store-info">
                <div class="store-name">${s.name}</div>
                <div class="store-address">${s.address}</div>
                <div class="store-hours">${s.hours}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="store-distance">${s.distance}</div>
            `;
            resultsEl.appendChild(card);
          });
        }, 800);
      });
    })();

    /* ── Newsletter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('newsletter-form');
      const confirm = document.getElementById('newsletter-confirm');

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = document.getElementById('email-input');
        const email = input.value.trim();
        if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
          input.focus();
          input.style.borderColor = '#E53E3E';
          setTimeout(() => { input.style.borderColor = ''; }, 2000);
          return;
        }
        const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        btn.textContent = 'Subscribing…';
        btn.disabled = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
          form.style.display = 'none';
          confirm.classList.add('visible');
        }, 700);
      });
    })();

    /* ── Mobile Nav ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const toggle = document.getElementById('nav-toggle-btn');
      const nav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');
      const close = document.getElementById('nav-close-btn');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('nav-backdrop');

      function openNav() {
        nav.classList.add('open');
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        close.focus();
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }

      function closeNav() {
        nav.classList.remove('open');
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        toggle.focus();
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      }

      toggle.addEventListener('click', openNav);
      close.addEventListener('click', closeNav);
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', closeNav);

      nav.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeNav();
      });

      nav.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', closeNav);
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Nunito:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    /* ── Reset & Tokens ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --green:       #2D6A4F;
      --green-light: #52B788;
      --green-pale:  #D8F3DC;
      --orange:      #F4A261;
      --orange-dark: #E07B39;
      --cream:       #FEFAE0;
      --cream-dark:  #F5EFC8;
      --text-dark:   #1A3028;
      --text-mid:    #3D5A50;
      --text-light:  #6B8F7E;
      --white:       #FFFFFF;
      --shadow-sm:   0 2px 8px rgba(45,106,79,.10);
      --shadow-md:   0 6px 24px rgba(45,106,79,.14);
      --shadow-lg:   0 16px 48px rgba(45,106,79,.18);
      --radius-sm:   10px;
      --radius-md:   18px;
      --radius-lg:   28px;
      --radius-xl:   40px;
      --transition:  200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      background: var(--cream);
      color: var(--text-dark);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

    /* ── Utility ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: clamp(16px, 5vw, 48px);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition), background var(--transition);
      letter-spacing: .3px;
    }

    .btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(45,106,79,.3);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: #235a41; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(45,106,79,.4); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--green);
      border: 2px solid var(--green);
    }
    .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--green); color: var(--white); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .btn-orange {
      background: var(--orange);
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(244,162,97,.35);
    }
    .btn-orange:hover { background: var(--orange-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(244,162,97,.45); }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 1.2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-sub {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(254,250,224,.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(45,106,79,.08);
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 68px;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: var(--white); }

    .logo-text {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .logo-text span { color: var(--orange); }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }
    .nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

    .header-cta { margin-left: 8px; padding: 10px 22px; font-size: 14px; }

    /* Mobile nav toggle */
    .nav-toggle {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .nav-toggle svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    /* ── Hero ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      padding: clamp(60px, 10vw, 100px) 0 clamp(48px, 8vw, 80px);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -120px;
      right: -180px;
      width: 640px;
      height: 640px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(82,183,136,.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px;
      left: -100px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244,162,97,.14) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--green-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.4); opacity: .7; }
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 64px);
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .hero-title span { color: var(--green); }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.8vw, 19px);
      color: var(--text-mid);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      max-width: 480px;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-stats {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .hero-stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 26px;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .hero-stat span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-light); font-weight: 600; }

    .hero-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .hero-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-card:first-child {
      grid-column: span 2;
    }

    .hero-card-img {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
    }

    .hero-card:nth-child(1) .hero-card-img { aspect-ratio: 16/7; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8F3DC 0%, #B7E4C7 100%); }
    .hero-card:nth-child(2) .hero-card-img { aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE8CC 0%, #FFDDB7 100%); }
    .hero-card:nth-child(3) .hero-card-img { aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9 0%, #C8E6C9 100%); }

    .hero-card-tag {
      position: absolute;
      top: 12px;
      left: 12px;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .hero-food-emoji { font-size: 56px; }

    /* ── Featured Products Carousel ───────────────────────────────── */
    .featured {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .featured-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .carousel-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--green);
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--green);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background var(--transition), color var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover { background: var(--green); color: var(--white); transform: scale(1.08); }
    .carousel-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .carousel-btn:active { transform: scale(.95); }
    .carousel-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    .carousel-track-outer {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      transition: transform 350ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      will-change: transform;
    }

    .product-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(25% - 15px);
      min-width: 220px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .product-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .product-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }

    .product-img {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 52px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .product-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px;
      right: 10px;
      background: var(--orange);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 50px;
    }

    .product-info { padding: 16px 18px 20px; }

    .product-name {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 5px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .product-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .product-footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .product-price {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .product-add {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
    }

    .product-add:hover { background: #235a41; transform: scale(1.12); }
    .product-add:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .product-add svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* Carousel indicators */
    .carousel-indicators {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .carousel-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--cream-dark);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
      padding: 0;
    }

    .carousel-dot.active { background: var(--green); transform: scale(1.35); }
    .carousel-dot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 3px; }

    /* ── Seasonal Picks ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .seasonal {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1B4332 0%, #2D6A4F 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .seasonal::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -60px;
      right: -60px;
      width: 360px;
      height: 360px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244,162,97,.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .seasonal-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .seasonal-head .section-label {
      background: rgba(244,162,97,.2);
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    .seasonal-head .section-title { color: var(--white); }
    .seasonal-head .section-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); max-width: 400px; margin-bottom: 28px; }

    .seasonal-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(244,162,97,.2);
      color: var(--orange);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .seasonal-tag svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    .seasonal-items { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }

    .seasonal-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .seasonal-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); transform: translateX(4px); }

    .seasonal-item-icon {
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 26px;
    }

    .seasonal-item-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

    .seasonal-item-name {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }

    .seasonal-item-desc { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); line-height: 1.4; }

    .seasonal-item-price {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--orange);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* ── Brand Highlights ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .highlights {
      background: var(--orange);
      padding: clamp(40px, 6vw, 60px) 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .highlights::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        45deg,
        rgba(255,255,255,.04) 0px,
        rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,
        transparent 1px,
        transparent 28px
      );
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .highlights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .highlight-item {
      padding: 16px 24px;
      text-align: center;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
    }

    .highlight-item:last-child { border-right: none; }

    .highlight-num {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .highlight-label {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .highlight-sub {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.65);
      margin-top: 4px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* ── Categories ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .categories {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: var(--cream);
    }

    .categories-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .categories-header .section-sub { margin-inline: auto; }

    .categories-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      aspect-ratio: 3/4;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .category-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .category-card:hover .category-bg { transform: scale(1.06); }

    .category-emoji { font-size: 48px; }

    .category-name-base {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 12px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .category-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,.82);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .category-card:hover .category-overlay,
    .category-card:focus-within .category-overlay { opacity: 1; }

    .category-overlay-name {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .category-overlay-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.8);
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .category-overlay-arrow {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.2);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .category-overlay-arrow svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: var(--white); }

    .category-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }

    /* ── Store Locator ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .locator {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .locator-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
      gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
      align-items: start;
    }

    .locator-form-wrap { position: sticky; top: 88px; }

    .locator-map-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-pale) 0%, #B7E4C7 100%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .locator-map-placeholder::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent 0px,
        transparent 39px,
        rgba(45,106,79,.06) 39px,
        rgba(45,106,79,.06) 40px
      ),
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        transparent 0px,
        transparent 39px,
        rgba(45,106,79,.06) 39px,
        rgba(45,106,79,.06) 40px
      );
    }

    .locator-map-icon { font-size: 52px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .locator-map-text { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; color: var(--green); font-weight: 600; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .locator-search-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .locator-input {
      flex: 1;
      height: 52px;
      border: 2px solid var(--cream-dark);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 0 18px;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      background: var(--cream);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
      outline: none;
    }

    .locator-input:focus { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--white); }
    .locator-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }

    .locator-search-btn {
      height: 52px;
      padding: 0 22px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    .store-results { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

    .store-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark);
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .store-card:hover { border-color: var(--green); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

    .store-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .store-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: var(--green); }

    .store-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .store-name { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dark); margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .store-address { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-light); line-height: 1.4; }
    .store-hours { font-size: 13px; color: var(--green); font-weight: 600; margin-top: 3px; }

    .store-distance {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--orange);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .store-empty {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 32px;
      color: var(--text-light);
    }

    .store-empty svg { width: 40px; height: 40px; margin: 0 auto 12px; fill: var(--cream-dark); }
    .store-empty p { font-size: 15px; }

    /* ── Newsletter ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .newsletter {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cream) 0%, #F0F9F4 100%);
    }

    .newsletter-inner {
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .newsletter-icon {
      width: 72px;
      height: 72px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--green-pale);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
      font-size: 34px;
    }

    .newsletter .section-title { margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .newsletter .section-sub { margin-inline: auto; margin-bottom: 32px; }

    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      max-width: 460px;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .newsletter-input {
      flex: 1;
      height: 52px;
      border: 2px solid var(--cream-dark);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 0 18px;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      background: var(--white);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }

    .newsletter-input:focus { border-color: var(--green); }
    .newsletter-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }

    .newsletter-submit { height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 12px; }

    .newsletter-confirm {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .newsletter-confirm.visible { display: flex; }
    .newsletter-confirm svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: var(--green); flex-shrink: 0; }

    .newsletter-perks {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .newsletter-perk {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .newsletter-perk svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: var(--green); }

    /* ── Footer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--text-dark);
      padding: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px) 0 0;
    }

    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.8fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: clamp(32px, 4vw, 60px);
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }

    .footer-brand .logo-text { color: var(--cream); }
    .footer-brand .logo-text span { color: var(--orange); }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-top: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      max-width: 280px;
    }

    .footer-social { display: flex; gap: 10px; }

    .social-btn {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .social-btn:hover { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); }
    .social-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .social-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: rgba(255,255,255,.7); }
    .social-btn:hover svg { fill: var(--white); }

    .footer-col-title {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-links { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--cream); }
    .footer-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

    .footer-bottom {
      padding: 20px 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-copy { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); }

    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-legal a { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); transition: color var(--transition); }
    .footer-legal a:hover { color: var(--cream); }

    /* ── Responsive ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .highlight-item { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); }
      .highlight-item:nth-child(even) { border-right: none; }
      .highlight-item:nth-child(odd) { border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); }
      .highlight-item:last-child, .highlight-item:nth-last-child(2):nth-child(odd) { border-bottom: none; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-visual { display: none; }
      .seasonal-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .locator-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .locator-map-placeholder { display: none; }
      .product-card { flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 10px); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links, .header-cta { display: none; }
      .nav-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; }
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .categories-grid .category-card:last-child { display: none; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
      .newsletter-submit { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 500px) {
      .product-card { flex: 0 0 calc(80vw - 32px); }
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .hero-stats { gap: 16px; }
    }

    /* ── Mobile Nav Drawer ────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 200;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open { display: block; }

    .mobile-nav-backdrop {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(26,48,40,.5);
    }

    .mobile-nav-panel {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: min(320px, 90vw);
      background: var(--cream);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .mobile-nav-close {
      align-self: flex-end;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-close svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    .mobile-nav-link {
      display: block;
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      transition: background var(--transition), color var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav-link:hover { background: var(--green-pale); color: var(--green); }

    /* ── Reduced motion ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

  <!-- ── Header ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->

            <li><a href="#about">About Us</a></li>
          </ul>
        </nav>

  <script>
    /* ── Carousel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carousel-prev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carousel-next');
      const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');

      let currentIndex = 0;
      let cardWidth = 0;
      let visibleCount = 4;
      const totalCards = track.children.length;

      function getVisibleCount() {
        const w = window.innerWidth;
        if (w <= 500)  return 1;
        if (w <= 900)  return 2;
        if (w <= 1100) return 3;
        return 4;
      }

      function maxIndex() {
        return Math.max(0, totalCards - visibleCount);
      }

      function updateCardWidth() {
        visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
        const outer = track.parentElement;
        const gap = 20;
        cardWidth = (outer.offsetWidth - gap * (visibleCount - 1)) / visibleCount;
        Array.from(track.children).forEach(c => { c.style.flex = `0 0 ${cardWidth}px`; });
      }

      function goTo(index) {
        currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, maxIndex()));
        const offset = currentIndex * (cardWidth + 20);
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;

        const dotCount = dots.length;
        const step = maxIndex() / Math.max(1, dotCount - 1);
        dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
          const active = Math.round(i * step) === currentIndex;
          dot.classList.toggle('active', active);
          dot.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        });

        prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= maxIndex();
        prevBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex === 0 ? '.45' : '1';
        nextBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex >= maxIndex() ? '.45' : '1';
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex - 1));
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex + 1));

      dots.forEach(dot => {
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dotIndex = parseInt(dot.dataset.index, 10);
          const step = maxIndex() / Math.max(1, dots.length - 1);
          goTo(Math.round(dotIndex * step));
        });
      });

      let resizeTimer;
      window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          updateCardWidth();
          goTo(Math.min(currentIndex, maxIndex()));
        }, 120);
      });

      updateCardWidth();
      goTo(0);
    })();

    /* ── Store Locator ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('locator-form');
      const resultsEl = document.getElementById('store-results');
      const emptyEl = document.getElementById('store-empty');

      const stores = [
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Lincoln Park',  address: '2140 N. Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60614', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '0.8 mi' },
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Wicker Park',   address: '1840 W. North Ave, Chicago, IL 60622', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '1.4 mi' },
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Lakeview',       address: '3745 N. Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60613', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '2.1 mi' },
      ];

      const mapIcon = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z"/></svg>`;

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const zip = document.getElementById('zip-input').value.trim();
        if (!zip) return;

        const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        btn.textContent = 'Searching…';
        btn.disabled = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15.5 14h-.79l-.28-.27A6.471 6.471 0 0 0 16 9.5 6.5 6.5 0 1 0 9.5 16c1.61 0 3.09-.59 4.23-1.57l.27.28v.79l5 4.99L20.49 19l-4.99-5zm-6 0C7.01 14 5 11.99 5 9.5S7.01 5 9.5 5 14 7.01 14 9.5 11.99 14 9.5 14z"/></svg> Search`;
          btn.disabled = false;

          if (emptyEl) emptyEl.remove();

          resultsEl.innerHTML = '';

          stores.forEach((s, i) => {
            const card = document.createElement('article');
            card.className = 'store-card';
            card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            card.setAttribute('aria-label', `${s.name}, ${s.distance} away`);
            card.style.animationDelay = `${i * 80}ms`;
            card.innerHTML = `
              <div class="store-icon">${mapIcon}</div>
              <div class="store-info">
                <div class="store-name">${s.name}</div>
                <div class="store-address">${s.address}</div>
                <div class="store-hours">${s.hours}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="store-distance">${s.distance}</div>
            `;
            resultsEl.appendChild(card);
          });
        }, 800);
      });
    })();

    /* ── Newsletter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('newsletter-form');
      const confirm = document.getElementById('newsletter-confirm');

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = document.getElementById('email-input');
        const email = input.value.trim();
        if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
          input.focus();
          input.style.borderColor = '#E53E3E';
          setTimeout(() => { input.style.borderColor = ''; }, 2000);
          return;
        }
        const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        btn.textContent = 'Subscribing…';
        btn.disabled = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
          form.style.display = 'none';
          confirm.classList.add('visible');
        }, 700);
      });
    })();

    /* ── Mobile Nav ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const toggle = document.getElementById('nav-toggle-btn');
      const nav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');
      const close = document.getElementById('nav-close-btn');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('nav-backdrop');

      function openNav() {
        nav.classList.add('open');
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        close.focus();
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }

      function closeNav() {
        nav.classList.remove('open');
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        toggle.focus();
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      }

      toggle.addEventListener('click', openNav);
      close.addEventListener('click', closeNav);
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', closeNav);

      nav.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeNav();
      });

      nav.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', closeNav);
      });
    })();
  </script>

<html lang="en">

  <style>
    /* ── Reset & Tokens ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {

      --radius-md:   18px;
      --radius-lg:   28px;
      --radius-xl:   40px;
      --transition:  200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {

      color: var(--text-dark);
      font-size: 16px;

    h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    /* ── Utility ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: clamp(16px, 5vw, 48px);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition), background var(--transition);
      letter-spacing: .3px;
    }

    .btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(45,106,79,.3);

    .btn-primary:hover { background: #235a41; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(45,106,79,.4); transform: translateY(-1px); }

      border: 2px solid var(--green);

    .btn-orange {

      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(244,162,97,.35);

      line-height: 1.65;

    /* ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(254,250,224,.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);

    .header-inner {

    .logo-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

    .logo-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: var(--white); }

    .logo-text {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--green);

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }
    .nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

    .header-cta { margin-left: 8px; padding: 10px 22px; font-size: 14px; }

    /* Mobile nav toggle */
    .nav-toggle {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .nav-toggle svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    /* ── Hero ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      padding: clamp(60px, 10vw, 100px) 0 clamp(48px, 8vw, 80px);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -120px;
      right: -180px;
      width: 640px;
      height: 640px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(82,183,136,.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px;
      left: -100px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244,162,97,.14) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--green-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.4); opacity: .7; }
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 64px);
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .hero-title span { color: var(--green); }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.8vw, 19px);
      color: var(--text-mid);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      max-width: 480px;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-stats {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .hero-stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 26px;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .hero-stat span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-light); font-weight: 600; }

    .hero-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .hero-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-card:first-child {
      grid-column: span 2;
    }

    .hero-card-img {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
    }

    .hero-card:nth-child(1) .hero-card-img { aspect-ratio: 16/7; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8F3DC 0%, #B7E4C7 100%); }
    .hero-card:nth-child(2) .hero-card-img { aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE8CC 0%, #FFDDB7 100%); }
    .hero-card:nth-child(3) .hero-card-img { aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9 0%, #C8E6C9 100%); }

    .hero-card-tag {
      position: absolute;
      top: 12px;
      left: 12px;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .hero-food-emoji { font-size: 56px; }

    /* ── Featured Products Carousel ───────────────────────────────── */
    .featured {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .featured-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .carousel-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--green);
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--green);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background var(--transition), color var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover { background: var(--green); color: var(--white); transform: scale(1.08); }
    .carousel-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .carousel-btn:active { transform: scale(.95); }
    .carousel-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    .carousel-track-outer {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      transition: transform 350ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      will-change: transform;
    }

    .product-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(25% - 15px);
      min-width: 220px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .product-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .product-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }

    .product-img {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 52px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .product-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px;
      right: 10px;
      background: var(--orange);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 50px;
    }

    .product-info { padding: 16px 18px 20px; }

    .product-name {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 5px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .product-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .product-footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .product-price {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .product-add {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
    }

    .product-add:hover { background: #235a41; transform: scale(1.12); }
    .product-add:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .product-add svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* Carousel indicators */
    .carousel-indicators {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .carousel-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--cream-dark);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
      padding: 0;
    }

    .carousel-dot.active { background: var(--green); transform: scale(1.35); }
    .carousel-dot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 3px; }

    /* ── Seasonal Picks ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .seasonal {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1B4332 0%, #2D6A4F 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .seasonal::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -60px;
      right: -60px;
      width: 360px;
      height: 360px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244,162,97,.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .seasonal-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .seasonal-head .section-label {
      background: rgba(244,162,97,.2);
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    .seasonal-head .section-title { color: var(--white); }
    .seasonal-head .section-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); max-width: 400px; margin-bottom: 28px; }

    .seasonal-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(244,162,97,.2);
      color: var(--orange);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .seasonal-tag svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    .seasonal-items { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }

    .seasonal-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .seasonal-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); transform: translateX(4px); }

    .seasonal-item-icon {
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 26px;
    }

    .seasonal-item-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

    .seasonal-item-name {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }

    .seasonal-item-desc { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); line-height: 1.4; }

    .seasonal-item-price {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--orange);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* ── Brand Highlights ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .highlights {
      background: var(--orange);
      padding: clamp(40px, 6vw, 60px) 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .highlights::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        45deg,
        rgba(255,255,255,.04) 0px,
        rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,
        transparent 1px,
        transparent 28px
      );
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .highlights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .highlight-item {
      padding: 16px 24px;
      text-align: center;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
    }

    .highlight-item:last-child { border-right: none; }

    .highlight-num {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .highlight-label {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .highlight-sub {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.65);
      margin-top: 4px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* ── Categories ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .categories {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: var(--cream);
    }

    .categories-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .categories-header .section-sub { margin-inline: auto; }

    .categories-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      aspect-ratio: 3/4;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .category-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .category-card:hover .category-bg { transform: scale(1.06); }

    .category-emoji { font-size: 48px; }

    .category-name-base {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 12px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .category-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,.82);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .category-card:hover .category-overlay,
    .category-card:focus-within .category-overlay { opacity: 1; }

    .category-overlay-name {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .category-overlay-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.8);
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .category-overlay-arrow {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.2);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .category-overlay-arrow svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: var(--white); }

    .category-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }

    /* ── Store Locator ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .locator {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .locator-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
      gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
      align-items: start;
    }

    .locator-form-wrap { position: sticky; top: 88px; }

    .locator-map-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-pale) 0%, #B7E4C7 100%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .locator-map-placeholder::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent 0px,
        transparent 39px,
        rgba(45,106,79,.06) 39px,
        rgba(45,106,79,.06) 40px
      ),
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        transparent 0px,
        transparent 39px,
        rgba(45,106,79,.06) 39px,
        rgba(45,106,79,.06) 40px
      );
    }

    .locator-map-icon { font-size: 52px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .locator-map-text { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; color: var(--green); font-weight: 600; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .locator-search-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .locator-input {
      flex: 1;
      height: 52px;
      border: 2px solid var(--cream-dark);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 0 18px;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      background: var(--cream);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
      outline: none;
    }

    .locator-input:focus { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--white); }
    .locator-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }

    .locator-search-btn {
      height: 52px;
      padding: 0 22px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    .store-results { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

    .store-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark);
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .store-card:hover { border-color: var(--green); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

    .store-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .store-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: var(--green); }

    .store-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .store-name { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dark); margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .store-address { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-light); line-height: 1.4; }
    .store-hours { font-size: 13px; color: var(--green); font-weight: 600; margin-top: 3px; }

    .store-distance {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--orange);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .store-empty {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 32px;
      color: var(--text-light);
    }

    .store-empty svg { width: 40px; height: 40px; margin: 0 auto 12px; fill: var(--cream-dark); }
    .store-empty p { font-size: 15px; }

    /* ── Newsletter ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .newsletter {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cream) 0%, #F0F9F4 100%);
    }

    .newsletter-inner {
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .newsletter-icon {
      width: 72px;
      height: 72px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--green-pale);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
      font-size: 34px;
    }

    .newsletter .section-title { margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .newsletter .section-sub { margin-inline: auto; margin-bottom: 32px; }

    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      max-width: 460px;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .newsletter-input {
      flex: 1;
      height: 52px;
      border: 2px solid var(--cream-dark);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 0 18px;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      background: var(--white);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }

    .newsletter-input:focus { border-color: var(--green); }
    .newsletter-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }

    .newsletter-submit { height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 12px; }

    .newsletter-confirm {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .newsletter-confirm.visible { display: flex; }
    .newsletter-confirm svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: var(--green); flex-shrink: 0; }

    .newsletter-perks {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .newsletter-perk {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .newsletter-perk svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: var(--green); }

    /* ── Footer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--text-dark);
      padding: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px) 0 0;
    }

    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.8fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: clamp(32px, 4vw, 60px);
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }

    .footer-brand .logo-text { color: var(--cream); }
    .footer-brand .logo-text span { color: var(--orange); }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-top: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      max-width: 280px;
    }

    .footer-social { display: flex; gap: 10px; }

    .social-btn {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .social-btn:hover { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); }
    .social-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .social-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: rgba(255,255,255,.7); }
    .social-btn:hover svg { fill: var(--white); }

    .footer-col-title {
      font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-links { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 14px;

  <script>
    /* ── Carousel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carousel-prev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carousel-next');
      const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');

      let currentIndex = 0;
      let cardWidth = 0;
      let visibleCount = 4;
      const totalCards = track.children.length;

      function getVisibleCount() {
        const w = window.innerWidth;
        if (w <= 500)  return 1;
        if (w <= 900)  return 2;
        if (w <= 1100) return 3;
        return 4;
      }

      function maxIndex() {
        return Math.max(0, totalCards - visibleCount);
      }

      function updateCardWidth() {
        visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
        const outer = track.parentElement;
        const gap = 20;
        cardWidth = (outer.offsetWidth - gap * (visibleCount - 1)) / visibleCount;
        Array.from(track.children).forEach(c => { c.style.flex = `0 0 ${cardWidth}px`; });
      }

      function goTo(index) {
        currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, maxIndex()));
        const offset = currentIndex * (cardWidth + 20);
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;

        const dotCount = dots.length;
        const step = maxIndex() / Math.max(1, dotCount - 1);
        dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
          const active = Math.round(i * step) === currentIndex;
          dot.classList.toggle('active', active);
          dot.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        });

        prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= maxIndex();
        prevBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex === 0 ? '.45' : '1';
        nextBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex >= maxIndex() ? '.45' : '1';
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex - 1));
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex + 1));

      dots.forEach(dot => {
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dotIndex = parseInt(dot.dataset.index, 10);
          const step = maxIndex() / Math.max(1, dots.length - 1);
          goTo(Math.round(dotIndex * step));
        });
      });

      let resizeTimer;
      window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          updateCardWidth();
          goTo(Math.min(currentIndex, maxIndex()));
        }, 120);
      });

      updateCardWidth();
      goTo(0);
    })();

    /* ── Store Locator ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('locator-form');
      const resultsEl = document.getElementById('store-results');
      const emptyEl = document.getElementById('store-empty');

      const stores = [
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Lincoln Park',  address: '2140 N. Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60614', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '0.8 mi' },
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Wicker Park',   address: '1840 W. North Ave, Chicago, IL 60622', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '1.4 mi' },
        { name: 'Fresh Pantry — Lakeview',       address: '3745 N. Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60613', hours: '8am – 9pm Daily', distance: '2.1 mi' },
      ];

      const mapIcon = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z"/></svg>`;

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const zip = document.getElementById('zip-input').value.trim();
        if (!zip) return;

        const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        btn.textContent = 'Searching…';
        btn.disabled = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15.5 14h-.79l-.28-.27A6.471 6.471 0 0 0 16 9.5 6.5 6.5 0 1 0 9.5 16c1.61 0 3.09-.59 4.23-1.57l.27.28v.79l5 4.99L20.49 19l-4.99-5zm-6 0C7.01 14 5 11.99 5 9.5S7.01 5 9.5 5 14 7.01 14 9.5 11.99 14 9.5 14z"/></svg> Search`;
          btn.disabled = false;

          if (emptyEl) emptyEl.remove();

          resultsEl.innerHTML = '';

          stores.forEach((s, i) => {
            const card = document.createElement('article');
            card.className = 'store-card';
            card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            card.setAttribute('aria-label', `${s.name}, ${s.distance} away`);
            card.style.animationDelay = `${i * 80}ms`;
            card.innerHTML = `
              <div class="store-icon">${mapIcon}</div>
              <div class="store-info">
                <div class="store-name">${s.name}</div>
                <div class="store-address">${s.address}</div>
                <div class="store-hours">${s.hours}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="store-distance">${s.distance}</div>
            `;
            resultsEl.appendChild(card);
          });
        }, 800);
      });
    })();

    /* ── Newsletter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('newsletter-form');
      const confirm = document.getElementById('newsletter-confirm');

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = document.getElementById('email-input');
        const email = input.value.trim();
        if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
          input.focus();
          input.style.borderColor = '#E53E3E';
          setTimeout(() => { input.style.borderColor = ''; }, 2000);
          return;
        }
        const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        btn.textContent = 'Subscribing…';
        btn.disabled = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
          form.style.display = 'none';
          confirm.classList.add('visible');
        }, 700);
      });
    })();

    /* ── Mobile Nav ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    (function () {
      const toggle = document.getElementById('nav-toggle-btn');
      const nav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');
      const close = document.getElementById('nav-close-btn');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('nav-backdrop');

      function openNav() {
        nav.classList.add('open');
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        close.focus();
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }

      function closeNav() {
        nav.classList.remove('open');
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        toggle.focus();
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      }

      toggle.addEventListener('click', openNav);
      close.addEventListener('click', closeNav);
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', closeNav);

      nav.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeNav();
      });

      nav.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', closeNav);
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
